_help: The contents guide window (UIContentsGuide.img, the modern client guide): x/y = the top-left of the window in 1366x768 game pixels (the window is 642x627, the art size), titleH = the height of the strip that drags the window. tab0X/tab1X/tab2X = the spot of the three tabs (field, boss, special), tabY = their top. fieldX/fieldY = the spot of the field list background. item0X..item3X = the spot of the four content icons, itemY = their top, nameDy = how far under the icon the name sits. listX/listY = the spot of the boss and special list backgrounds. bossNameX/bossNameY = the spot of the first boss name, bossNameStep = the height of one boss slot. specialNameX/specialNameY = the spot of the first special name, specialNameStepX = the distance to the next special column. closeX/closeY = the spot of the X button, minX/minY = the spot of the minimize button, helpX/helpY = the spot of the help button.
